title: In nested CALCULATE the inner filter on a column overrides the outer filter on the same column
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], Customer[Country] = "JP" ), Customer[Country] = "US" ) )

source.quote: the default behavior of CALCULATE overrides the outer filters in 'Geography'[State Province Code] and substitutes its own filter arguments, because the filters apply to the same column
source.supports: the page's '$$ in WA and OR ??' expression: the inner CALCULATE's filter replaces the outer filter on the same column

derivation: The outer filter Country = US is applied first; the inner Country = JP then overwrites it. JP: rows 5, 6 = 200 + 30 = 230. (US would be 310, and an intersection BLANK.)
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
